name: Meteoric-Fjard
description: Bare rock from pole to pole, shaded in grays, ox-blood reds, and pale magnesium white. The regolith records four billion years of bombardment, scarred through by dust seas stretching to the horizon near the terminator.
Light is the weather here. It swings from merciful to murderous within an hour, and everyone schedules their lives around it.
Something about this world resists explanation. Every expedition answers three questions and returns with five better ones.
There is money in titanium, uranium and silicon and history in the rocks, and the two keep interfering with each other. Mediators do brisk business at inflated rates.
